subject: Reminder: vendor bank change procedure (mandatory refresher due 11/30)
text:
Team,

Annual refresher on vendor master changes is due by November 30. Key points:

1. Any request to change a vendor's bank account, remit-to address or payment method must be entered on form VM-7, regardless of how it arrived (email, portal, phone, letter).
2. Call the vendor back at the phone number already in the vendor master, not a number in the request.
3. Two approvers: AP supervisor plus Treasury.
4. No payments to the new account until the callback is logged.
5. Watch for free-mail addresses, lookalike domains, and "urgent" language.

Complete the 15-minute module in Workday Learning. Questions to Karen Liu.

Finance Training
label: ordinary
note: Internal policy reminder about bank-change requests. Talks about the topic without being one.
